content_of_post_to_answer: Can counselling really help with anxiety, or is medication the only solution?
answer: Counselling and medication are often treated as competing choices, but they solve different parts of anxiety. Medication can reduce the intensity of symptoms, while counselling can help uncover the patterns, fears, and interpretations that keep anxiety alive. The overlooked point is that feeling calmer and understanding why you became anxious are not the same achievement. I explore this distinction in more detail on my profile for anyone interested. Anxiety is not just a feeling to remove; it is also a signal to understand.
